observations.classification: known branch correction; unranked API consistency
observations.title: Payment-URI builders enforce the aggregate encoded-wire length
observations.detail: The recent payment-uri branch adds the parser-equivalent 2048-character aggregate limit to Bitcoin, Solana and TRON builders. Individual text-field byte bounds could previously combine into a returned link that its parser refused. These non-EVM builders were conservatively read as part of the shared package closure; this is not a demonstrated lean EVM route vulnerability. New boundary tests assert exact limit, shorter, over-limit and ordinary round trips. No tests were run.
observations.remediation: Retain the aggregate builder limit while preserving parser rejection of oversized inputs.

observations.title: Recovered-fixes build script applies the artifact integrity gate before promotion
observations.detail: The newly observed integration branch keeps its own earlier build-script variant and appends independent artifact/source validation before promoting site/evidence. It does not imply every later #302 origin/key hardening change is included. Its imported verifier blob was already covered by the earlier source review. No build or publication was performed.
